Card Q&A.a: No, you can't. The activation conditions include paying 3 cost and placing this card as 1 of your [Legend-Arms] trait or 1 of your level 6 Digimon's bottom digivolution card, therefore the effect can't be activated just by paying 1 cost.
Card Q&A.q: Can I use this card's [Main] effect to pay 3 cost even when I don't have any [Legend-Arms] trait or level 6 Digimon?
Will a [RagnaLoardmon] with this card as a digivolution be deleted by an effect that deletes a Digimon when activated by my opponent?

Effect: {Hand} [Main] By paying 3 cost and placing this card as 1 of your [Legend-Arms] trait or 1 of your level 6 Digimon's bottom digivolution card, ＜De-Digivolve 1＞ all of your opponent's Digimon with as much or less DP as that Digimon.
[When Digivolving] Until the end of your opponent's turn, 1 of your Digimon isn't affected by the effects of your opponent's Digimon.
Inherited Effect: [Opponent's Turn] While this Digimon is [RagnaLoardmon], this Digimon can't leave the battle area other than by your effects or deletion.
